content.short: Mynth is a cross-chain intents protocol that abstracts tokens to live on every chain.
content.description: Mynth is a cross-chain intents protocol that abstracts tokens to live on every chain. Mynth - Tokens, unchained. Mynth supports seamless asset conversion and easy arbitrage, operating across blockchains, by simplifying the process of asset swaps through a straightforward and user-friendly interface. Users select the synthetic asset they wish to exchange and provide the receiving address for the corresponding real-world asset. Mynth maintains a pool of assets to facilitate the transactions, and a team of professional arbitrage traders, supported by artificial intelligence, manages the asset conversions.
